Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Add database migrations, documentation, and production-ready configuration

This commit completes the SharePoint Permission Sync system with production-ready
database setup, comprehensive documentation, and safe migration strategy.

Changes:
- Configure DbContext to exclude existing production tables from EF migrations
  (Engagement, Project, Interaction, InteractionMembership now use ExcludeFromMigrations)
- Add EF Core migration for new queue tracking tables (ProcessingJobs, ProcessingJobItems)
- Create database setup SQL scripts for both business tables and queue tables
- Add comprehensive CODE_REVIEW.md analyzing architecture and comparing with proven patterns
- Add QUICK_START_GUIDE.md with step-by-step instructions for running and testing
- Include test CSV file with sample permission sync data

The system is now ready for deployment with proper separation between existing
production tables (read-only) and new queue management tables (migrations enabled).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
